decision: Grant Steward bounded authority to close GitHub issues only under the enumerated closure rules A1 to A5, with per-run caps, a writesEnabled kill switch, and an exactly-once outcome record (#2130)?
whyItMatters: The upstream and bot-report backlog grows faster than it is closed by hand, and most of it is work the registry already preserved. Closing is visible to the founder, so the rule set is narrow: only an item whose payload is proven preserved may be closed, and nothing is closed on a similar title, a stale issue, or a skipped child gate.
evidence: Decided by founder (campaign brief 2026-10-21) under #2130. This record is the authority; no agent inference grants closure.

Allowlist (POLICY.yaml issueHygiene.enabledRules): A1-child-curated, A2-umbrella-synced, A3-umbrella-superseded, A4-duplicate-child, A5-botreport-superseded. Each rule has a positive and a negative test in tests/steward/issuehygiene.
A5 cannot fire until issueHygiene.a5Disabled names a workflow file that is verifiably disabled in repository files; the list is empty, so A5 stays inert.
Caps: maxClosuresPerRun 10 (code ceiling 25), maxCensusAgeSeconds 21600, closedWindowDays 30. Any stale, incomplete or unreconciled census blocks closure for the run.

Each closure re-reads the issue and requires the same updatedAt, bodySha256 and labels as the reconciled snapshot; otherwise it is skipped and re-observed. Outcomes are recorded once per semantic key and survive resume.
recommended: Rollout in the order of the architecture contract: dry-run the manifest on the live census, pilot at most five closures under the A1 rule, then expand in checkpointed batches of at most ten. Rollback at any point by setting issueHygiene.writesEnabled to false in founder/steward/POLICY.yaml; no further closure is emitted and closures already made stay closed.
alternative: Keep every closure Class B: a person reviews each proposal and closes each issue by hand. Slower, but no automated closure authority exists.
unblocks: Class A closure debt (issue_closure_ready) may emit forge.close_issue actions. Without this record the rule set has no authority and emits nothing.
